global_selection: highest mean of the predeclared bidirectional risk-set composite across two windows and three seeds among 54 completed global development runs; exact ties prefer fewer parameters, then fewer auxiliary losses
parent_checkpoints: same selected global architecture and objective, own seed and cutoff; original tensors and metadata preserved
checkpoint: final EMA after four extra epochs, no epoch selection
execution_note: GPU memory and wall times are recorded per process; concurrent wall time is not a hardware-isolated speed comparison
unchanged_training: cutoff-only BCE, old retrieval and any already-selected observed query/assay losses; all parent weights remain trainable
capacity_control: same parent plus zero-output residual MLP, parameter-matched to the geometry refinement
new_information: site adds DrugCLIP atoms/bonds and mapped ESM2 site residues; geometry adds receptor-only CA messages
retention: retain local complexity only if it improves the aggregate development composite against both continued-global and matched-capacity controls, improves against continued-global in each window, and wins the paired composite in at least two of three seeds after averaging windows
geometry_increment: geometry additionally must improve against site in each window and in at least two of three paired seed composites
capacity_refinement_retention: extra capacity must improve against continued-global in each window and in at least two of three paired seed composites
uncertainty: report seed variation and paired-query intervals; no multiple-testing-corrected or prospective claim
final_global_or_local_selection: compare original selected global, continued global, capacity control and eligible local refinements by the same development composite; retain no unsupported local module
representative_deployment_seed: closest to the selected model's median two-window development composite; smallest seed breaks ties
temporal_refit: global training epochs are the rounded median of all six selected global parent epochs; any retained refinement uses four extra epochs
tests: 2023-2025 and KIRHub are previously opened regressions, never used to select architecture, training epochs or deployment seed
